scripts:
set properties on /content/dam/aem-hybrid-calix/jcr:content
  set cq:conf{String} to /conf/aem-hybrid-calix
  set jcr:title{String} to "AEM Hybrid Calix"
end

# --- AEM public read access for the site ---
# All site content, DAM assets, and experience fragments are publicly
# readable. No deny ACEs are set.
create group site-members with path /home/groups/aem-hybrid-calix
set ACL for everyone
    allow jcr:read on /content/aem-hybrid-calix
    allow jcr:read on /content/aem-hybrid-calix/us/en
    allow jcr:read on /content/aem-hybrid-calix/us/en/login
    allow jcr:read on /content/experience-fragments/aem-hybrid-calix
    allow jcr:read on /content/dam/aem-hybrid-calix
    allow jcr:read on /conf/aem-hybrid-calix
    allow jcr:read on /apps/aem-hybrid-calix
end
set ACL for site-members
    allow jcr:read on /content/aem-hybrid-calix/us/en
end
